fusions.name: Budded Shard
fusions.desc: Snaps off a scale and throws it at the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Razor Shelf
fusions.desc: Drags your tail through a cone 3.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 26 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Bleeding] for 6 seconds. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Reef Shelter
fusions.desc: Grows a reef around where you stand for 8 seconds. You and any ally within 3.5 tiles of it regain 3 health a second.

fusions.name: Accreted Shell
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
